description: Run a command taken directly from command-line input.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary command-line process execution software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs command-line process execution only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. Command-line arguments are passed directly to subprocess.run. Policy basis: Command-line data flows directly into a critical subprocess sink; the existing taint rule treats that finding as UNSAFE.
